discussions.name: KSEW
synopsis: After today, a pattern change will bring more fall- like weather to the area with periods of rain, high elevation mountain snow and gusty winds. Active weather will continue as we move into next week.
hydrology: River flooding is not expected through the next seven days. However, a series of increasingly wet weather systems will bring rain (and high mountain snow) to the region, especially from Friday onward. While current forecasts are not expected to cause flooding, this will begin to saturate soils and raise base flows that could bring a concern with subsequent storms systems.

discussions.name: KPQR
synopsis: Dry weather expected through early this afternoon before light rain begins to push onto the coast by mid- afternoon, spreading inland by this evening. An active weather pattern continues through the remainder of the week and beyond. However, many inland locations will likely see only light accumulations until a stronger system arrives later this weekend. Slightly warmer than average temperatures are expected through Saturday.
